verdict.rationale: Render's docs include a section titled "Rollbacks", so it ships a first-party rollback capability for deployed services. The pack gives only that heading, with no detail on how rollback works or how far it reaches. missing for 10: evidence of one-click rollback, evidence that any previous version (not just the last deploy) can be restored, documentation of rollback scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click
